spellbook.finance/limitations: Each viewUrl expires at viewUrlExpiresAt. Read the order again for a fresh link.
A line in linesWithoutPhoto has no stored photo. That does not prove the line was not packed.
An order_not_found error means no line in this workspace carries that marketplace and order id.
Photos are seller-captured images. SpellBook verifies neither their content nor a delivery.

annotations.title: Read an order's packing proof photos

description: Read the packing proof photos for ONE order: a view link for each pull line the packer photographed, with card name, finish, condition and capture time, plus the order's lines that have no photo. Use it to answer whether an order's cards were photographed before shipping, or to gather evidence for a dispute. Photos come from the packer's own camera in the pull flow. This tool only reads them and cannot upload one.

marketplace.description: The marketplace the order came from. Required.

orderId.description: The marketplace's order id exactly as the order lists it. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that shipped the order, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_order_proof_photos
